messages:
sam: Heads-up: console shows p99 for /generate->ingressFragment shot up after the canary. endpoint-level p99 looks fine but this slice is way up (280ms -> ~900ms). anyone digging?
maya: link? query?
sam: the quick one I used:
```
select percentile(0.99, duration_ms) from requests
where ingress_fragment = '/generate/ingressFragment' and time >= now() - interval '2 hours'
```
liam: that's a rollup query. telemetry added `is_retry` + `fanout_count` fields last week; rollup merge currently collapses those dims so you can get retry/fanout-inflated percentiles.
arthur: confirm: events have `is_retry` and `fanout_count` but rollup key only keeps ingress_fragment + endpoint; we lose per-shard fanout detail. that will make pctl look worse if one hotspot retried a lot.
sylvie: so two things: retries and client-side fanout/backpressure. they both push the tail. we should surface sample_count and fanout_percentile in the UI.
maya: for SLOs, should we exclude retries and heavy-fanout requests by default? product asked for stable SLOs.
liam: pragmatic approach: SLO tiles exclude `is_retry=true`. For fanout, expose a toggle or choose median fanout weight threshold to exclude absurd fanouts (> 4). diagnostic panes show include/exclude.
arthur: telemetry impl note: when computing pctl rollups, keep two rollup records: one SLO-rollup (filter is_retry and fanout_count > 4) and one full-rollup. Add metadata fields: sample_count, retry_count, fanout_p95. that keeps UI cheap.
sam: could we instead attach a small provenance flag to each rollup like `rollup_variant: "slo_filtered"` so we don't break the existing query layer?
liam: yes. we'll add rollup_variant and document query semantics. also worth adding `legacy_includes_retries=true` for old rollups so backfill is auditable.
telemetry-bot: ingest: `is_retry` and `fanout_count` indexed since 2026-03-20T23:40:00Z.
sylvie: UX: add a compact badge next to pctl tiles: "SLO view" with small i-tooltip explaining filters and a link to "Show raw". also surface sample_count and retry_ratio on hover.
maya: product note: Ben asked SLO history shouldn't jump. we need a migration plan + backfill validation.
arthur: I'll run a backfill that recomputes SLO-rollups for the last 90 days and produce a diff report (per-endpoint p99 delta). if deltas > 2% we'll flag product.
liam: I'll open telemetry#4410 (create slo_filtered rollups + metadata), console#1201 (slo-badge + raw toggle + tooltip copy), and ops#77 (backfill validation runbook). assign telemetry#4410 to me, console to sylvie.
sam: small ask: can we show both p99_slo and p99_raw side-by-side in the breakdown view? that helps incident triage.
sylvie: good idea. I'll mock a split-pill with two values and color-code them. jess? (wait jess not here)
maya: Thanks. please keep the initial canary verification scoped: I'll validate SLO-rollup against canary traffic and sanity-check the first 7 days of backfill.
arthur: will post backfill summary in this thread when ready.
liam: also note: when rollup_variant present, existing saved charts should keep referring to their variant_id; we'll add a migration shim to default old charts to `legacy_includes_retries=true` to avoid surprises.
telemetry-bot: ticket telemetry#4410 created: "slo_filtered rollup + rollup_variant metadata"
liam: console#1201 and ops#77 filed. assigning console to sylvie, ops to arthur.
sam: moving on, thanks all. we'll regroup after backfill. :thumbsup:
